# Clinical Advisor

> Clinical Advisor is a comprehensive medical education and news platform for nurse practitioners, physician associates, and healthcare professionals covering clinical research, drug treatments, disease management, and healthcare policy.

The site provides peer-reviewed clinical content, continuing medical education (CME/CE), diagnostic case studies across specialties, and healthcare law resources. It serves as a primary resource for evidence-based clinical decision-making and professional development in primary care and specialty medicine.

## Key Topics

- Clinical cases and case studies
- Medical education and CME/CE
- Clinical news and drug treatments
- Nurse practitioners
- Dermatology and diagnostic imaging
- Cardiovascular disease
- Diabetes management
- Disease management
- Healthcare law and compliance
- Patient education
- FDA and regulatory updates
- Diagnostic reference materials
- Health disparities
- Immunology and vaccines
- Allergy management

## Clinical Education & CME

- [Clinical Advisor CME/CE Courses](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/clinical-advisor-cme): Practice-relevant CME/CE courses for healthcare professionals with myCME platform integration.
- [Special Collections](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/special-collections): Curated clinical education resources including Care Compass, Case Challenge, and clinical reference materials.
- [Clinical Advisor Submission Guidelines](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/clinical-advisor-submission-guidelines): Submission guidelines for peer-reviewed journal focused on nurse practitioners and physician associates.

## Clinical Cases & Diagnostic Resources

- [Cases Archives](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/subjects/cases): Clinical case studies across specialties with diagnostic features and medical education resources.
- [DermDx Dermatology Cases](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/derm-dx-cases): DermDx dermatology case studies with diagnostic imaging and clinical education for skin conditions.
- [OrthoDx Orthopedic Cases](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/ortho-dx-cases): OrthoDx orthopedic case studies with diagnostic imaging for musculoskeletal injury diagnosis.
- [Clinical Challenge Archives](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/hm-article-type/clinical-challenge): Emergency medicine clinical challenges for diagnostic reasoning and patient presentation education.

## Clinical News & Features

- [News Archive](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/news): Archive of clinical news covering medical research, drug treatments, and healthcare policy from CDC and HHS.
- [Features Archive](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/features): Archive of clinical features with case studies, guidelines, and expert roundtables on disease management.
- [AdvisorForums Archive](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/advisorforums): Healthcare forum featuring memorable patient cases and clinical experiences from practitioners.

## Specialty & Disease-Specific Content

- [Cardiovascular Archives](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/subjects/cardiovascular): Cardiovascular news on heart failure, stroke prevention, coronary artery disease, and cardiology updates.
- [Diabetes Archives](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/subjects/diabetes): Diabetes news covering type 2 diabetes, medications like semaglutide, glucose management, and treatment.
- [Dermatology Archives](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/subjects/dermatology): Dermatology updates on skin conditions, psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, melanoma, and immunotherapy.
- [Allergy and Immunology Archives](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/subjects/allergy-and-immunology): Allergy/immunology news on penicillin allergies, vaccines, food allergies, and immunocompromised patients.
- [Diet and Nutrition Archives](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/subjects/diet-and-nutrition): Nutrition news on dietary guidelines, food insecurity, chronic disease prevention, and food policy.

## Patient Education & Reference

- [Fact Sheets Archives](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/hm-article-type/fact-sheets): Patient education fact sheets providing clinical reference on medical conditions and diagnostic guides.

## Professional Development & Legal Resources

- [Conferences](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/conferences): Directory of medical conferences and professional development events for nurse practitioners and clinicians.
- [Legal Advisor Archives](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/hm-article-type/legal-advisor): Legal case analysis on healthcare law, malpractice, liability, and regulatory compliance for NPs.

## Optional

- [Multimedia](https://www.clinicaladvisor.com/multimedia): Medical videos and multimedia series on NASH treatment, pharmacologic therapy, and patient education.
